okio@2.8.0 is shaded inside the druid-iceberg-extensions fat-JAR as a transitive dependency via OkHttp/Apache Iceberg. Fix requires a 2.x->3.x major version bump (breaking API change) blocked on upstream Apache Iceberg adopting okio 3.x. Druid's own upstream OWASP suppressions note all okio requests are internal and not user-facing. Monitor apache/iceberg upstream.
